summary: CAVA Group filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a share repurchase program on September 17, 2026, authorizing up to $100 million of outstanding common stock. Repurchases may occur in the open market, via privately negotiated transactions, or through Rule 10b5-1 trading plans at management's discretion, funded by existing cash and operating cash flow. The program expires September 17, 2027, is non-binding, and may be modified, suspended, or terminated at any time. No price, premium, stake, advisor, or close date was stated; watch actual buyback pace as a signal of management's valuation view and possible support for the stock.
